exact: endogenous peptide antigen processing and presentation via MHC class II

definition: The process in which an antigen-presenting cell expresses a peptide antigen of endogenous origin on its cell surface in association with an MHC class II protein complex. The peptide antigen is typically, but not always, processed from a whole protein.
label: antigen processing and presentation of endogenous peptide antigen via MHC class II
